name: dedupe-lines
prompt: Remove duplicate lines from langs.txt while preserving the first-appearance order (go, rust, python).
verify: test "$(sort langs.txt | uniq -d | wc -l)" -eq 0 && grep -qx go langs.txt && grep -qx rust langs.txt && grep -qx python langs.txt && test "$(wc -l < langs.txt)" -eq 3
